hero.sub: Laddu, Mysore pak, murukku and mixture, packed fresh and delivered to your door.

story.title: Our story
story.body: Every box that leaves our kitchen is made the way it has always been made at home. The ghee is warmed slowly, the flour is sifted, and the syrup is tested between two fingers until it threads just right. Nothing is hurried, and nothing is left out.
story.quote: Made the way it has always been made at home.

combos.title: Gift boxes
combos.sub: Fixed boxes of our most-loved sweets and savories. Packing included.

process.title: How a box is made
process.s1: Gram flour and rava are roasted slowly until the kitchen smells nutty.
process.s2: Murukku and thenkuzhal are pressed by hand straight into hot oil.
process.s3: Sugar syrup is cooked to the right thread for jangiri, badhusha and pak.
process.s4: Everything cools fully, then gets weighed, sealed and labelled for you.
